managed-skills-settings.title: Skills
managed-skills-settings.description: Import and manage Worker-owned skill packages on a selected Runner Device.
managed-skills-settings.chooseRunner: Choose a Runner Device to inspect its skill packages.
managed-skills-settings.future: Changes apply to new execution generations. Accepted copies and history keep their original packages.
managed-skills-settings.unsupported: Skill management is unavailable. Update the server and the selected Runner Device.
managed-skills-settings.readHelp: Check the selected Runner connection, permissions and skill management capability, then refresh.
managed-skills-settings.invalid: The Runner skill catalog could not be verified. Refresh before making changes.
managed-skills-settings.nativeUnavailabl: No verified native profile. Every execution verifies its own process again.
managed-skills-settings.confirmDelete: Delete the managed copy of “{{name}}” from this Runner catalog? Current Agent Worker references block deletion.
managed-skills-settings.retained: Accepted execution, Fork and Sidechat copies keep their original ownership. Their cleanup is separate.
managed-skills-settings.source: Package directory on the selected Runner Device
managed-skills-settings.sourceHelp: Enter the absolute directory that contains SKILL.md. Import copies bounded regular files and never modifies the source.
managed-skills-settings.writeHelp: Retry the original request or refresh the catalog. A revision conflict requires a fresh read.
managed-skills-settings.uncertain: The operation is unconfirmed. Retry the original request to recover its result.
managed-skills-settings.cancelHelp: Cancel the original import and remove only its original incomplete copy. A completed import must be recovered first and then deleted from the catalog.
